posts.body_html:
Can't believe this clone hasn't gotten any thread-love in so long! Let me just say that I love this plant. It's a slow grower, but MAN is it unique and beautiful! It's consistently one of the last flavas to bloom and open traps, and I suspect this more leuco-like timing may reflect hybridization with that species a few generations back. It's looking *KILLER* this year and I was able to get some pics this evening when the sun came out after a crazy thundershower.
Untitled by Calen Hall, on Flickr
Untitled by Calen Hall, on Flickr
It always stands out in the flava hedge!
Untitled by Calen Hall, on Flickr

I have a super high S. flava 'Suspicion' that this clone originated from an atropurpurea:
